question: Can one explicit predecessor attest the exact supplied set of its own signed key-rotation-revocation packets through a historical completeThrough boundary without claiming global freshness, referenced-rotation validity, authority transfer, discovery, or consensus?
proved: exact supplied same-predecessor packet-id manifest binds count and digest
omission or substitution changes the signed manifest result
checkpoint evaluation requires the explicit expected predecessor
foreign predecessor packets cannot enter another predecessor checkpoint manifest
packets issued after completeThrough are not covered
expired checkpoint becomes stale and unknown clock holds
not_proved: absence of newer or unseen rotation revocations
globally newest or unique rotation branch
truth_boundary: ROTATION_REVOCATION_SET_ATTESTED_THROUGH means only that the explicitly expected predecessor signed a checkpoint whose exact count and digest match the supplied valid same-predecessor key-rotation-revocation packet ids through the named historical completeThrough boundary while the checkpoint itself is temporally usable. It does not separately validate referenced rotations or establish current global revocation state.
